paper.title_en: Status of the polarized gas target for the LHCspin project
paper.abstract_en: The LHCspin project is a future experimental project to install a polarized gas target within the LHCb detector at CERN Large Hadron Collider (LHC) in order to study the internal (spin-) structure of protons and neutrons. A key requirement of the project is the development of a high-performance polarized target system, which consists of three major components: an Atomic Beam Source (ABS), a target chamber, and a polarization measurement system. The project is structured in two phases. Phase I focuses on the development of the new target system and conducting feasibility tests and preliminary measurements at the LHC Interaction Region 4 (IR4) during LHC Run 4. In Phase II, the developed target system is foreseen to be integrated into the LHCb detector at IR8 to make use of new probes in a poorly explored kinematical region for the precise measurements of quark and gluon distributions.
